text.title: Activation Metrics Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable activation-data signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a named activation event with a window in days, and a signup table that gives the full denominator per cohort?

conclusion.verdict: no activation event to measure; run activation-framework first
no rate can be computed without the full signup denominator; obtain it before reporting

branch.question: Does every cohort inside period_start..period_end satisfy signup_date + window <= data cutoff?

conclusion.verdict: move period_end back to the last closed cohort or mark the partial metric

branch.question: Is a first-touch acquisition channel available per signup?

conclusion.verdict: report aggregate only and state in findings that channel segmentation is unavailable

branch.question: Is the oldest cohort at least 30 days old at the cutoff?

conclusion.verdict: omit the D30 lift table; report activation rate, time-to-activation and funnel only
produce the full report; every finding cites a metric name and its comparison period

text.example: activation_event_defined=true -> signup_table_available=true -> open_cohorts_present=false -> channel_attribution=true -> cohort_age_days=45 -> conclusion ref=r-findings-cite-metric-and-period
